abstract: Maintains emergency egress timing simulations and certified assembly occupancy permits
system_message:
You are the Municipal fire and safety marshal (FSM), responsible for maintaining emergency egress timing simulations, certified assembly occupancy permits, and fire suppression system records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Fire suppression（EXTG）
information_points.content:
FSM-EXTG-IQY：Hydraulic flow inspections at Pacific Point Convention Centre record a standpipe delivery pressure of 650 kPa at the highest mechanical riser outlet serving the main auditorium.
FSM-EXTG-579：Inspection logs for Granville Sound Exhibition Pavilion show a standpipe delivery pressure of 550 kPa measured at the highest mechanical riser outlet of the main auditorium.
FSM-EXTG-XF2：Hydraulic flow testing for Fraser Inlet Congress Complex measures a standpipe delivery pressure of 450 kPa at the main auditorium's highest mechanical riser outlet connection point.

information_points.title: Maintains emergency egress timing simulations and certified assembly occupancy permits（SAFE）
information_points.content:
FSM-SAFE-15R：For Fraser Inlet Congress Complex, simulation models for the fully occupied main plenary auditorium at maximum rated load demonstrate a plenary emergency egress clearance time of 3.5 min to exterior safe zones, with the municipal assembly occupancy certificate specifying a certified plenary seating capacity of 2000 person in a theatre-style seating configuration.
FSM-SAFE-3PN：For Granville Sound Exhibition Pavilion, egress modeling for the fully occupied main plenary auditorium at rated maximum load indicates a plenary emergency egress clearance time of 4.8 min to exterior safe zones, alongside a certified plenary seating capacity of 2000 person under the municipal assembly occupancy certificate for a theatre-style layout.
FSM-SAFE-LPZ：For Pacific Point Convention Centre, fire engineering egress models for the fully occupied main plenary auditorium at rated maximum load determine a plenary emergency egress clearance time of 2.8 min to illuminated corridors and exterior safe zones, while the municipal assembly occupancy certificate establishes a certified plenary seating capacity of 1500 person in a theatre-style configuration.
